title: NBA Offseason Daily Digest
subtitle: July 26, 2026 – Free Agency Heats Up, Trades Reshape Landscape, and Summer League Crowns a Champion

items.headline: LeBron James Headed to Philadelphia 76ers
items.summary: In the offseason's most seismic move, four-time MVP LeBron James has reportedly committed to joining the Philadelphia 76ers, creating a formidable new contender in the Eastern Conference. This decision comes after widespread speculation linking James to several teams, including a potential return to the Cavaliers or a move to the Warriors.

items.headline: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope Joins 76ers After Grizzlies Buyout
items.summary: Veteran guard Kentavious Caldwell-Pope has reached a buyout agreement with the Memphis Grizzlies and is expected to sign with the Philadelphia 76ers, further bolstering their roster alongside newly acquired LeBron James. Caldwell-Pope averaged 8.4 points and 21.9 minutes in 51 games last season.

items.headline: Warriors Eyeing Trade Market After Missing Out on James
items.summary: With LeBron James signing with the 76ers, the Golden State Warriors are reportedly intensifying their search for a difference-maker on the trade market to return to title contention. The team is also expected to re-sign Draymond Green at nearly $28 million after he declined his player option.

items.headline: Blockbuster Trades Reshape League Landscape in July
items.summary: July has seen a flurry of major trades, including Giannis Antetokounmpo moving to the Miami Heat, LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves, Ja Morant heading to the Portland Trail Blazers, and Walker Kessler joining the Los Angeles Lakers in a sign-and-trade. The Boston Celtics also traded Jaylen Brown to the 76ers for Paul George and draft compensation.

items.headline: Heat in Talks with DeMar DeRozan and Bradley Beal
items.summary: The Miami Heat have reportedly engaged in conversations with unrestricted free agents DeMar DeRozan and Bradley Beal following LeBron James' decision to join the 76ers. Both veterans could provide significant scoring and playmaking to Miami's roster. DeRozan was waived by the Kings, while Beal declined his $5.6 million player option.

items.headline: Notable Free Agent Signings Across the League
items.summary: Several key free agents have found new homes this offseason. Mitchell Robinson has signed with the Boston Celtics, Norman Powell inked a 2-year, $45 million deal with the Chicago Bulls, Keon Ellis joined the Brooklyn Nets, Dean Wade signed with the Philadelphia 76ers, Bogdan Bogdanovic and Marcus Smart headed to the Houston Rockets, Mike Conley returned to the Boston Celtics, and both Collin Sexton and Quentin Grimes joined the Los Angeles Lakers.

items.headline: Golden State Warriors Claim 2026 NBA Summer League Title
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors emerged as champions of the 2026 Las Vegas NBA Summer League, defeating the Memphis Grizzlies in the final. Michigan product Yaxel Lendeborg was named both the Championship Game MVP and the overall Summer League MVP for his dominant performance, including 21 points and 10 rebounds in the final.

items.headline: Offseason Coaching Carousel Continues Across NBA
items.summary: The 2026 offseason has seen a significant number of coaching changes as teams retool their leadership. Among the notable hires, Taylor Jenkins took over the Milwaukee Bucks, Jamahl Mosley was named head coach of the New Orleans Pelicans, Sean Sweeney joined the Orlando Magic, Dusty May was hired by the Dallas Mavericks, Tiago Splitter became the new head coach of the Chicago Bulls, and Micah Nori took the helm of the Portland Trail Blazers.

items.headline: Kenneth Lofton Jr. Signs with Hapoel Jerusalem in Israel
items.summary: Former NBA forward Kenneth Lofton Jr. has signed a contract with Hapoel Jerusalem through the 2026-27 season, embarking on his first European professional campaign. He joins a revamped roster under new head coach Sasa Obradovic.
